name: zclass_node_set_damage_hit_callback
description: zClass_Node::SetDamageHitCallback allocates or reuses a damage handler, installs the hit callback/context when empty, propagates the handler, and sets the node hit-callback flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this callback setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass/OptCatalog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b25a0 validates allocating a 0x10-byte handler when missing, rejecting replacement when hitContext is already set, storing callback/context, propagating the handler, and calling gwNodeSetHasHitCallback with one.
The native smoke verifies allocation, subtree propagation, callback/context storage, duplicate-hit rejection, and hit flag setting.
